author: Thisis Digs
title: **We Placed a Senior animator now need a Junior **
content: **We Placed a Senior animator now need a Junior ** **HIRING: Junior Children’s Book Animator (Remote) | ₱50K/month** A well-established UK children’s book publisher is starting a new animation strand and is looking for a junior animator to join the project. You’ll help bring their illustrated picture books to life on YouTube, in social media shorts and through QR codes printed in the books. **What you’ll do** * Animate original 2D illustrations from layered PSD files * Use AI tools alongside traditional animation to keep production efficient * Help create short 3D logo idents and other animated assets * Support storyboarding and help improve the workflow as it develops **What we’re looking for** * Character animation skills, with a good sense of timing and appeal for young audiences * Some hands-on experience with AI animation tools, or a strong interest in learning them * Basic 3D skills * Eager to learn, open to feedback, and able to communicate in clear English * 1–2 years’ experience, or a strong portfolio from study or personal projects **Nice to have:** motion graphics, YouTube or social content, children’s animation, a showreel with AI-assisted work **Pay:** ₱50,000 per month **Details** * Flexible hours, with some overlap with UK mornings (from about 2:00 PM PHT) * Start as soon as possible * Use your own computer and software **To apply:** email your CV, portfolio and showreel to [daniel@shorelink.io](mailto:daniel@shorelink.io) with the subject “Junior Children’s Book Animator Application”.
